description.delete-session: The session and its {{cards}} will be discarded. Cards already transferred to collections are kept.
description.index-not-loaded: The card index could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
description.scope: Narrowing the scan down to the release you are currently sorting makes it faster and stops it confusing cards from other sets.
description.sessions: Each session collects scans for one pile — several can be open at once. Transfers go from the session into its target collection.
description.sessions-empty: Start a new session to scan cards — or open a collection and scan straight into it.
